records.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
records.synopsis: The publisher describes a mysterious threat approaching Earth, bringing Kirk and a newly refitted Enterprise back into service for an urgent defense mission.

records.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
records.synopsis: A former exile with extraordinary engineered abilities seeks revenge against Kirk, forcing the admiral to face the consequences of an earlier encounter.

records.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
records.synopsis: After Spock's apparent death, the studio's description places evidence of his survival on the Genesis planet, where his body had been taken.

records.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
records.synopsis: With Earth imperiled in their own era, the Enterprise crew travels to the 1980s aboard a Klingon vessel to bring back whales that may avert disaster.

records.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
records.synopsis: Sybok, Spock's half-brother, takes control of the Enterprise and sets a course toward the galactic center in pursuit of a being he regards as divine.

records.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
records.synopsis: A catastrophe at a key Klingon energy facility makes peace negotiations possible. Kirk's crew escorts the Klingon leader toward talks while factions on both sides try to prevent reconciliation.

records.title: Star Trek Generations
records.synopsis: The studio synopsis brings Captains Picard and Kirk together through a time-defying phenomenon and has them combine their efforts against a planetary threat.

records.title: Star Trek: First Contact
records.synopsis: The Borg travel into Earth's past, and Picard sends the Enterprise after them to protect a historic first warp-spaceflight.

records.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
records.synopsis: Picard challenges a Starfleet plan to move a planet's inhabitants so others can exploit the world's unusual natural properties.

records.title: Star Trek Nemesis
records.synopsis: An engineered duplicate of Picard pursues vengeance and endangers the Federation using a weapon capable of widespread destruction.

records.title: Star Trek (2009)
records.synopsis: A young Kirk struggles with expectations tied to his father's legacy while a future-displaced Romulan directs his grief and anger against the Federation.

records.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
records.synopsis: An attack deep inside Federation territory sends Kirk's crew across hostile space in pursuit of a dangerous opponent with extraordinary abilities.

records.title: Star Trek Beyond
records.synopsis: During an extended mission into unexplored space, the Enterprise encounters a new adversary who tests both the crew and the Federation principles they represent.

records.title: Star Trek: Section 31
records.synopsis: The studio announcement describes Philippa Georgiou joining a covert Starfleet organization tasked with defending the Federation while she confronts the consequences of her past.
